Hi Fernando and CJ,

Thanks for sending the full output file, Fernando. I was able to verify that the problem you encountered is now fixed in the development version (https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation), which will soon be released to CRAN as v0.7. CJ, your issue was a bit more peculiar, reflecting the empty section header for I1, but no subsequent parameter. I haven't seen this output before (or since), so it must be a rare occasion. I emulated this by adding the line from your output into an existing file and encountered the same bug. I've now incorporated a workaround into the package that skips over blank sections, which is also fixed in the development version of the package.

Best,
Michael
